deviations.what: Every missing new_classes is set to 0 and nothing ever sets it to NA when n_base_classes is 0, so an empty-base firm-year gets 0 (no forward patents) or |F| (the anti-join on line 22 against an empty base counts every forward class), where the spec requires NA.

notes: Everything else matches the spec: filing-year dating, first-listed codes only, missing/empty classes dropped, duplicates removed, base window t-5..t-1 (fy+1..fy+5) and forward window t+1..t+3 (fy-3..fy-1) with year t in neither, empty forward with a non-empty base giving 0, firm-level grouping, and one row per distinct firm_year with the required columns. The code does not limit output to focal years 1987-2015; that is fine if firm_year already holds only those years.
